Reproduced this issue on latest main commit and took a flamegraph with `bun run --cpu-prof src/index.ts serve` while continuing a long session. This causes 100% CPU usage and really slow conversation. The PR https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/10190 seems to be fixing this issue properly. After fixing that cloning issue the flamegraph looks something like This can be fixed with a 1-line patch like `const sessionMessages = clone(msgs)` -> `const sessionMessages = step > 1 && lastFinished ? structuredClone(msgs) : msgs` utilizing Bun fast structuredClone.

I suppose my issue is technically specific to `--session`, but I'm suspecting it's the same root cause!

The clone call is incredibly expensive. I suspect due to the reference saving mechanism and linear lookup:

https://github.com/remeda/remeda/blob/047c93e314bb9351b3ab93b34ce4b6cf67df7b1d/packages/remeda/src/clone.ts#L80

Replacing it with `const sessionMessages = structuredClone(msgs)` call directly is much faster. Still takes 1352ms in this case, suggesting a large `msgs` object.
